title: Amazing
body:
I never write reviews but I just had to for this one. I have just finished my first live body double session and it was honestly transformative. 

I have never had such ease doing my tasks. The host Luisa was wonderful and welcoming. Normally I have to hold myself back from asking for positive reinforcement from those around me while I task because, let’s be real, I’m an adult and not a child who needs their hand held to get chores done. I didn’t even feel the need to ask during this, the encouragement and compliments came freely and without judgement. It made the dopamine flow and everything was fun.

I completed a task that has been on my to do list for months that I’ve been pretending isn’t there. No anxiety, no procrastination. Just got it done. 

I’m glad I invested in the subscription. I will be attending the session in two hours as well. I have much to do and this is giving me the motivation. The monthly cost will be completely worth it. 

Thank you so much for making this app. If you’re debating about getting it and getting the subscription, do it. It’s amazing, so simple but so effective.
author: Robin Dabanque

title: If you struggle with starting tasks, give this app a go!
body: Having not heard of body doubling until seeing this app on social media, I wanted to give it a go. And have not been disappointed yet, it makes task feel much smaller and takes away issues with starting a task.
author: Georgia P 20

title: Awful app
body:
This App has been the biggest waste of my time. For a start up app to have so many in app purchases, is just insane. 

It’s designed to help neurodivergent individuals. 
All I can say is this app done nothing for my ADHD. It’s just two social media creators making how to videos. There is nothing else, just them. Sure I can watch them on fb/insta or tik tok for free and get more help. 

You are taking complete advantage of people struggling with their day to day lives, just so you can line your pockets

I loved watching you on social media, some of the skits you do would resonate so much with me. This is app is purely to help them both line their pockets. 

Where is the actual support??? No Chat rooms, no threads, no proper advice. Just two people laughing and joking about adhd etc. it’s funny online, not on an app supposed to help people. 

Neurodivergent you DO NOT need this app. Purchase CBT for dummies workbook. I promise that will change your mind. 

I apologise for the long post, I just don’t want anyone else drawn in by the promise of help to be met with locked videos. And a free trial video 🤦🏼‍♀️
author: TheBee34
